algorithm.description: Quorum algorithm: 'ffsplit' (fixed first split) or 'lms' (linearizable multi-state). Most clusters use 'ffsplit'.

heuristics.description: List of shell commands executed as quorum heuristics. Commands must return 0 for 'up', non-zero for 'down'. Example: ['ping -c1 -W1 192.168.1.1', 'test -e /var/run/storage-ready'].

heuristics_interval.description: Interval in seconds between execution of heuristics commands to determine node health.

ip.description: IP address of the qdevice host. If omitted, auto-detected. Only set if you want to override automatic resolution.

logging.description: Logging configuration. Controls verbosity and target of qdevice logs.

models.description: Model-specific parameters. Common keys: 'net', 'knet'. Structure depends on the model used.

nodes.description: List of nodes (cluster members) that are allowed to use this qdevice. Usually auto-populated, but can be explicitly set.

ip.description: IP address of the node (optional, auto-detected if omitted).

port.description: UDP port for qdevice communication. Standard port is 5403.

reconnect_interval.description: Seconds to wait before attempting to reconnect after a failure.

tie_breaker.description: Strategy for breaking ties during quorum decisions: 'lowest' (use lowest node ID), 'highest', or 'nodeid:ID' (specific node).

timeout_connect.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds before retry.

timeout_exec.description: Timeout in milliseconds for qdevice operation (e.g., vote request).

tls.description: TLS security settings. Enable or disable TLS and configure trust.

enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for qdevice communication.

tls_ca.description: Path to TLS CA certificate for trust verification (if TLS enabled).

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate used for client authentication (if TLS enabled).

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key (if TLS enabled).
